resolution.question: The Riverton marathon starts Sunday at 07:00. Will the Alder Court neighbors, who have discussed it all month on the app, actually set up their planned water table before the first runners pass around 08:30?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the water table was actually set up at the Alder Court corner before 2026-10-11T08:30:00-06:00 (i.e., before the first runners pass). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
